episodes.synopsis: The leader of the criminal esper organization P.A.N.D.R.A is imprisoned in the jail for espers, Deadlock. There he meets a man with unusually colored eyes who catches his interest, Andy Hinomiya.
episodes.title: Paranormal Jailbreak -Schooler of deadlock-

episodes.synopsis: As Andy begins to familiarize himself within P.A.N.D.R.A, he is given his first mission to assassinate a mafia leader.
episodes.title: The Melody of Assassination -Ghost of WW2-

episodes.synopsis: P.A.N.D.R.A has kidnapped Princess Sophie a Pro-Esper activist. The plan to do so was formulated by non-other than Yugiri.
episodes.title: Cleanliness and Pollution -Queen not a Princess-

episodes.synopsis: Hyobu Kyosuke has ordered the Catastrophe back to Japan where they at met with a warm welcome from old friends.
episodes.title: Absolute Domain -Children Territory-

episodes.synopsis: The crew enjoys some free time shopping. Andy treats Yugiri to a special treat but its cut short when he is visited by B.A.B.E.L with some important information.
episodes.title: Strangers -Portrait of the family-

episodes.synopsis: Not only is the secret of the Catastrophe is revealed but so has Andy’s hidden agenda. Does he have the power to stand against the Major?
episodes.title: Darkness, Run -As true as a lie-

episodes.synopsis: After his father’s death, Baron Tsubomi took in Kyosuke and raised him with his daughter Fujuko, a sensory user. Together with other sensory users they help form Japans first Special ESP Unit.
episodes.title: ESP Unit Part One -Generation ZERO PART I-

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke has been chosen to represent the E.S.P unit in the Navy war games. The Units future is on his shoulders.
episodes.title: ESP Unit Part Two -Generation ZERO PART II-

episodes.synopsis: The American government has made their move with a full on assault against the Catastrophe, but their real intentions are unknown even to their spy; History will repeat itself.
episodes.title: Catastrophe -Pandora's box opens-

episodes.synopsis: Old foes thought long gone, have been exposed as the mastermind behind the plans to sink the Catastrophe is taking Yugiri. This new information re-ignites the fire in Kyosuke as he shakes off death to get his revenge.
episodes.title: The Distant Paradise -Original Sin-

episodes.synopsis: New York has a new Mayor that is in support of esper relationships, at the same time Hyobu and Andy work their way into the USEI facility only to discover…
episodes.title: The Two Within the Storm -Outlaws-

episodes.synopsis: Saotome plan is finally coming to fruition and with no one powerful enough to stop it, the world will be saved from Hyobu Kyoskue.
episodes.title: To The Future -Last Resolution-
